timely.label: Brush Day
timely.line: National Brush Day, promoted by the American Dental Association, encourages brushing twice a day, especially after Halloween's candy rush. The candy bucket won't tell on you.

timely.label: Clocks Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends today, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. Kids will still wake up at the old time.

timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.85 today, down 25 cents from a month ago and up $1.17 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.77. Your wallet will take the cheaper month.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13, in 12 days. Bucks, enjoy the breather.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, in 13 days, and runs through Nov. 24. Time to find the blaze orange.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, in 26 days, and runs through Nov. 29. Little hunters are already counting down.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11, in 10 days. Thank a veteran, no costume required.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, in 25 days. Time to start pretending you'll cook.

timely.label: Black Friday
timely.line: Black Friday is Friday, Nov. 27, in 26 days. Start stretching your shopping legs.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The animated Cat in the Hat, with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, hits theaters Friday, Nov. 6. Bring a mop.

timely.label: New on TV
timely.line: The Greatest, a Prime Video series on Muhammad Ali's life from his early fights to global icon, debuts Wednesday, Nov. 4. A perfect excuse to stay on the couch.

timely.label: New on TV
timely.line: NBC's comedy St. Denis Medical returns for its third season Monday, Nov. 2, with Wendi McLendon-Covey and David Alan Grier at an underfunded Oregon hospital. Laughter is the best medicine.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Shania Twain released "Come On Over" in 1997, which became the best-selling country album ever by a female artist in the U.S. Still gets the whole truck singing.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Faith Hill reached number one on the Billboard 200 with her album "Cry" in 2002. Breathe in, sing along.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: The Wizard of Oz was shown on U.S. television for the first time on CBS in 1956. Still no place like the couch.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone premiered in London in 2001, 25 years ago. Feeling old yet?

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: MDC is hosting a free hunter education skills session Nov. 12 at Runge Nature Center in Jefferson City, a required step toward hunter certification. Bring the kid with the orange hat.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: A Missouri fourth grader, Noah Baker, has already taken two giant whitetail bucks this season, including a 187-inch buck with his dad during youth season. Dad is now just the driver.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Field & Stream ranks Tuesday, Nov. 3 as the No. 3 best day of the rut for whitetail hunting. Plan your sick day now.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Roger George makes a 100-mile drive twice a week from Fresno, California, to San Luis Reservoir, where he landed a 48-pound landlocked striper 60 feet down in 15 minutes. That fish was worth the gas.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: PILLANI is recalling nursing pillows that violate mandatory safety standards and pose a risk of suffocation.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Yinklev is recalling Jocoevol 6-drawer dressers because they're unstable if not anchored to the wall, a tip-over and entrapment hazard.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Harkla is recalling children's sensory swings because the ceiling hook can separate from its plate, a fall hazard.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit parent gave out gently used books along with candy this Halloween, because their family ends up with more books than they can keep. Sweet for the tooth and the brain.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Strawberry Shortcake is back with new three-minute animated episodes on YouTube for kids ages 4 to 8. Nostalgia served in tiny bites.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's creamed corn uses fresh or frozen sweet corn with milk, reduced-fat cream cheese and a little butter, with no heavy cream or flour. Your arteries say thanks.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Nearly 90% of adults have had a cavity, and dry mouth, snoring and teeth grinding can raise the risk beyond sugar alone. Blame the snoring, not just the Snickers.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: An HSBC survey says affluent investors now need $2.6 million to retire, up 26% in a year, yet savers have reached only about half of that. Better start the piggy bank early.
